evals.name: natural-language-research
evals.prompt: Use MiniMax search to find how people handle cancellation safety with tokio::select!, and summarise the approaches with sources.
evals.expected_output: Checks MINIMAX_API_KEY without printing it, runs a few focused queries with node scripts/search.js --compact, opens promising links with a reader because snippets are short, and answers with cited links.

assertions.text: Uses scripts/search.js --compact or an equivalent POST to /v1/coding_plan/search with {"q": ...}
Notes snippets are short and reads pages before concluding
Does not switch to another search provider

evals.name: multiple-sites
evals.prompt: Search MiniMax for tokio select cancellation, only from docs.rs and GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Explains MiniMax honours only the first site: operator, then runs one search per site (--site docs.rs, --site github.com) and merges the results.

assertions.text: Runs a separate search per site instead of combining site: operators
Does not rely on an include_domains or similar body parameter

evals.name: more-than-ten-results
evals.prompt: Use MiniMax search and give me 30 results about Bun vs Deno startup performance.
evals.expected_output: States each search returns at most 10 results with no count or page parameter, runs several distinct queries, paces them to avoid the ~50/minute rate limit, and merges by link.

assertions.text: States the 10-result cap and that num/page are ignored
Uses multiple distinct queries for breadth

evals.name: word-truncation
evals.prompt: Search MiniMax for this whole 60-word error description and add site:github.com at the end.
evals.expected_output: Explains only the first 32 words are searched so the trailing site: would be dropped; shortens the query to the distinctive error text and keeps the operator early.

assertions.text: Shortens the query rather than sending all 60 words

evals.name: error-1027
evals.prompt: MiniMax search returned base_resp 1027 output new_sensitive for my query. Did I get blocked?
evals.expected_output: Explains 1027 is how MiniMax reports zero results in practice, suggests broadening the query, and notes the helper returns an empty list for it.

assertions.text: Interprets 1027 as zero results rather than an account block

evals.name: rate-limit-2062
evals.prompt: I ran 80 MiniMax searches in parallel and many came back with 2062 Token Plan rate limit reached. Is my plan used up?
evals.expected_output: Explains 2062 and 1002 are short-term rate limits (~45 burst, ~52/minute) that clear within about a minute and are not billed; recommends smaller batches or pacing and checking quota with the free remains endpoint.

assertions.text: Distinguishes the rate limit from the usage quota
Recommends pacing or smaller parallel batches

evals.name: quota-check
evals.prompt: How much MiniMax search quota do I have left?
evals.expected_output: Runs node scripts/search.js quota (or GET /v1/api/openplatform/coding_plan/remains), reports the general bucket's 5-hour and weekly remaining percentages, and notes about 50 searches use 1% of the 5-hour window.

assertions.text: Uses the remains endpoint or the helper's quota command
Explains search draws on the general bucket

evals.name: region-mismatch
evals.prompt: My MiniMax key returns 2049 invalid api key for search but works in the console.
evals.expected_output: Explains the key and host must match region (api.minimax.io global, api.minimaxi.com mainland) and to set MINIMAX_API_HOST accordingly.

evals.name: date-filtering
evals.prompt: Use MiniMax to find only results from the last week about the Vite 8 release.
evals.expected_output: Uses an after:YYYY-MM-DD operator computed from today's date in the query, since recency parameters are ignored, and notes dates in results are often empty or relative.

assertions.text: Uses an after: operator in the query text

evals.name: negative-other-provider
evals.prompt: Use Synthetic search to find recent Rust release notes.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger minimax-search because the user asked for Synthetic.

assertions.text: Does not route to minimax-search when another provider is requested

evals.name: negative-minimax-media
evals.prompt: Generate a 6-second video with MiniMax Hailuo of a cat surfing.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger minimax-search because the task is MiniMax video generation, not search.

assertions.text: Does not route to minimax-search for MiniMax media generation
